Korean naturally places the data-file relative clause before the requested project noun. This is a single source cue and no named item, number or condition moves into another cue.

Distinguishing order preserves the earlier 1+6 versus 6+1 explanation; the independent-dice model remains explicit in unchanged 21c1bc. The author text 둘-to-두 wording preserves the value two; the recommended 2개 form makes that quantity machine-readable without changing meaning.
